title: Global criticism during Covid hardened China's stance towards world: Misri
description:
Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri said that during COVID-19, China felt blamed and stigmatised by the international community for the pandemic, leading to a harsh attitude toward the outside world and a draconian lockdown within its borders.
Speaking on Saturday at the Iqwat Global Business Conclave, an event organised by an association of Kashmiri Pandits.
Misri also recalled that he faced a major challenge during his posting in China as Ambassador, when India and China had an unprecedented confrontation in eastern Ladakh's Galwan Valley.
For the first time in nearly 50 years, lives were lost on both sides at the Line of Actual Control, he noted.
What made it particularly challenging was that it happened at the height of COVID-19, which imposed limitations on interactions, understanding domestic perceptions in China and travelling back to Delhi, Misri said.
